verdict.rationale: Sentry's official CLI docs say it is primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS and Android. They also say these files let Sentry extract stack traces for most compiled platforms, and a community comment confirms Sentry ships its own Symbolicator. Missing for 10: explicit naming of dSYM and ProGuard mapping upload, evidence that symbolication resolves to function names and line numbers, and independent hands-on corroboration of the upload-to-symbolication workflow.
